sources.title: Statistically Valid Post-Training Hyperparameter Selection: From Tuning to Guarantees
sources.read_range: Chapter2 MHT/Bonferroni and fixed-sequence ordering; Chapter5 split Pareto theorem excerpt; distribution-shift limitation
sources.decision: Use conceptual distinction between tuning and simultaneous validation; no FDR/fixed-sequence/aLTT implementation or metric reuse. Candidate generation should be separate from valid calibration evidence.

sources.title: ReCIRC: Rectified Conformal Risk Control
sources.read_range: §2.1;§4.1 Assumptions4.1–4.3; AppendixF.1/F.2 proof excerpts; AppendixH false-discovery example
sources.decision: Candidate input-dependent risk rectification only; monotone bounded exchangeable ordered family and protective endpoint required. Marginal expected risk differs from high-probability population/conditional control; arbitrary nonmonotone indexer metrics fail premise.
